subject: Atlas Exec Immersion — arrival windows, travel blocks, and AV runbook
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@atlashealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Exec immersion — preferred dates and high-level asks

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Leadership here is aligned on a two-day exec immersion at our SF campus to review integration planning and cost/perf targets. High-level asks: a focused 2-hour leadership briefing (Day 1 AM), a 3-hour technical deep-dive (Day 1 PM), and customer-facing workshop with product + platform teams (Day 2).

Preferred windows: October 18–19 or October 25–26. We expect 8–10 Atlas attendees (mix of execs + platform) and will host up to 6 Redwood folks on site.

Can you share your recommended arrival windows for Redwood, any hotel block suggestions, and AV requirements? Also please send a calendar hold for the proposed dates so we can reserve conference rooms.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Sarah
Sarah Li
Director, Strategic Programs
Atlas Health
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion — preferred dates and high-level asks

Hi Sarah — great to hear Atlas is ready to lock this in. Either date range works for us; lean toward Oct 25–26 to give our eng leads a little runway after a product ship.

Quick answers up front:
- Arrival windows: Redwood team would plan for morning arrival on Day 0 (Oct 24) for setup and runbook dry-run; majority of presenters can arrive evening of Oct 24 or first thing Oct 25.
- Hotel block: Marissa, can you confirm a recommended block near the campus (walkable preferred)?
- AV / room needs: Connor, see Sarah's ask — can you outline minimum AV and an optional enhanced setup (recording + stereo mics)?

I'll put tentative calendar holds on both ranges (Oct 18–19 and Oct 25–26) and update when we confirm. Attendee list from Atlas will help finalize headcounts for meals and room layout.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion — hotel block options + travel windows

Evelyn / Connor —

I reached out to our vendor contacts near Atlas HQ and have three practical options (pricing and cut-off dates in attached PDF):
1) Camden Suites — 6 rooms blocked (walking 8 min), flexible cancellation through Oct 1. Shuttle available.
2) Harbor Inn — 8 rooms (onsite breakfast), slightly further but better weekday rates.
3) Parkside Executive — 10 rooms, complimentary airport transfers for groups of 6+.

Recommendation: Parkside Executive for comfort for execs and the transfer benefit. I'll place a soft hold (no CC yet) for Oct 24–27 and send the confirmation once Atlas confirms headcount.

Also: travel window guidance for Redwood presenters — arrive Oct 24 afternoon/evening; anyone with red-eye risk can do Oct 25 morning but request they be on the setup call Oct 24 6pm PT.

Attachments: Hotel_Block_Options_Sep07.pdf

—Marissa
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion — AV runbook and room layout needs

Hi all — looping in baseline + upgraded options. Short version for Atlas:
- Minimum: podium laptop HDMI, single lapel mic for presenter, 2x ceiling speakers (room-provided), HDMI cable + 1x clicker. Recording via Zoom (hosted from Atlas laptop).
- Enhanced (recommended for exec briefing & customer-facing sessions): 2x wireless lapels, stereo tabletop mics for panel, integrated recorder (16k stereo), HDMI splitter for live stream + local recording, spare laptop, and stage monitor.
- Connectivity: wired ethernet for Redwood presenter laptop (hotel/venue often flaky).

I'll attach Venue_Audio_Specs.pdf with cabling diagram. If Atlas wants session recordings to be post-processed, we can arrange capture via our engineer (adds one headcount).

Connor
Solutions Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@atlashealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion — arrival windows, travel blocks, and AV runbook

Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the hotel options. Atlas confirms Oct 25–26. Headcount: 9 Atlas attendees (3 execs, 6 platform/product). Redwood onsite: 5 (Evelyn, Marissa, Connor, and two engineers).

We'd like the enhanced AV for Day 1 (exec briefing + tech deep-dive) and minimum for Day 2. Hotel block: please secure Parkside Executive with a 10-room block (we will reimburse/no CC required from Redwood). Can you put a calendar hold for Oct 24 setup (4pm–7pm), Oct 25 full day (8:30am–6pm), Oct 26 half day (8:30am–1pm)?

Also attaching a first-pass attendee list and dietary restrictions.

Attachments: Atlas_Attendee_List_Sept.pdf

Best,
—Sarah
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion — arrival windows, travel blocks, and AV runbook

Perfect — thank you, Sarah. I placed the following calendar holds and shared them with both teams (links below):
- Oct 24, 16:00–19:00 PT — Redwood setup & runbook dry-run (tentative)
- Oct 25, 08:30–18:00 PT — Day 1 (exec briefing + tech deep-dive)
- Oct 26, 08:30–13:00 PT — Day 2 (customer workshop)

Marissa: please finalize Parkside block and send the confirmation PDF; add shuttle info to the shared Drive. Connor: please confirm preferred pickup time for Redwood AV equipment on Oct 24 evening.

Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=atlas-immersion-20271025; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aTlas-Exec-Immersion-Prep

I'll create a one-pager runbook (timings, POCs, escalation matrix) and circulate by Sep 14. If either Atlas or Redwood wants a 30-minute rehearsal with AV on Oct 24 18:00 PT, please RSVP.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Evelyn
Head, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
